shot_preferences: Wide action shots showing full vehicles in motion
Include environment (orange tracks, city, garage) in background
Vehicle + character together, not just character alone
Peak action moments: mid-jump, flames shooting, car soaring
avoid: Cockpit-only views where vehicle exterior is not visible
Static portraits when text describes motion/action
Shots where the car is cropped or barely visible

scoring_guidance: This is an ACTION franchise. Frames showing full vehicles in motion are preferred over character close-ups. Wide shots of cars racing, jumping, or flying should score higher. Cockpit-only views should score lower unless specifically needed.

visual_description.good: Close-up of Coop gripping the GT Scorcher's steering wheel, knuckles white with tension. His eyes narrow with determination. Cut to wide shot: the sleek orange car with flame decals rockets toward a massive loop-de-loop. Tires squeal against the track. The car launches off the ramp, flames shooting from the exhaust, soaring over a 50-foot gap. Coop's face shifts from concentration to pure joy, mouth open in a victory scream. Below, the crowd of campers gasp, hands raised. The car lands with a skid, kicking up a cloud of dust.
visual_description.bad: Coop races his car and jumps

video_analysis.character_appearance_example: Dash Wheeler - adult woman with short brown hair, wearing white racing suit with blue accents

story_writing.opening: It was another awesome day in Hot Wheels City- the city that never breaks! Coop drove his favorite car, the GT Scorcher, in the race of the century. He hit a ramp, soared through the air, and crossed the finish line as the crowd went wild.
story_writing.setup: Coop joined the other kids as a shiny green car, the Twin Mill, skidded to a stop. Out hopped Dash Wheeler, leader of the Ultimate Garage! She welcomed all six kids to camp: Spark, Mac, Brights, Axle, Sidecar, and Coop. 'You six were chosen because you have what it takes to be the next generation of Hot Wheels Racers!' Dash told them.
story_writing.problem: 'Oh, no!' Coop cried. The tire rolled across the Hot Wheels Lab and out the open window! 'I'm sure that happens all the time!' Mac said, trying to make Coop feel better. 'Breaking news!' said a reporter on TV. 'A tire has been launched into Hot Wheels City for the very first time!'
story_writing.climax: The GT Scorcher's tires squealed as it rocketed forward, with flames shooting out the back. Then it hit a ramp and began to soar over the gap in the tracks like in Coop's daydream. 'YEAH!' he screamed in delight. [bold]'Super Speed Burst activate! Go, Hot Wheels!'[/bold]
story_writing.resolution: 'Smart move choosing the GT Scorcher,' Dash told Coop. 'You picked a car fast enough to catch that wacky wheel.' 'The key was to never give up,' Coop declared. Plus, he had help from his super awesome new friends!
